title: A lot confused - An Update
text:
Update: After contacting the seller they were also confused. The puppy pads should never have been sent to me. They very promptly sent out the missing 2 treats. Very much appreciate the customer service and quick response.

---
The product description includes the following for what comes in the box: "Each month you'll receive: 2 treats or chews, 2 toys, and LIMITED EDITION BANDANA only available from Dapper Dog."

Our box included 2 toys, a bandana, and (instead of 2 treats or chews) a set of puppy training pads. For my almost 4 year old, completely potty trained, 95lb German Shephard. I am not sure who was more disappointed, me or the dog. Am contacting the seller.
label: positive
